cleaner.label: pytest (Python)
cleaner.description: Temporary folders of the latest pytest runs. Does not touch projects or .pytest_cache folders.

option.label: pytest temporary folders
option.description: Removes the contents of the pytest-of-user folders in the temporary folder.
option.warning: You lose the files produced by tests in the latest runs (tmp_path), useful for understanding a failed test. Do not clean while pytest is running.
